# Checkbox

One or many independent on or off choices, usually sent with a form.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-checkbox--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Checkbox examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-checkbox--docs">Open Checkbox in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-checkbox--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** Terms and preferences.

- **Use it when:** Agreeing, picking many, optional extras; the choice waits for the form.
- **Not when:** Exactly one of a short set (radio group), or a setting that applies at once (switch).

Instead:

- [Radio group](./radio-group.md): One choice only.
- [Switch](./switch.md): Applies at once.
- [Select](./select.md): Many options in a compact list.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Space checks and unchecks. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Each checkbox has a visible label that is part of the hit area. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add checkbox
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Checkbox reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.
